214	// createIntent runs every creation check and records the placement intent for
215	// a primary loaded by loadPrimary. actor is who asked for the placement, and
216	// placementID is the id the request reserved. The native_mirror_create runner
217	// calls it once per job.
218	func (s *NativeMirrorService) createIntent(ctx context.Context, primaryID model.RepoID, primary nativeMirrorPrimary, clusterSlug string, actor model.AccountID, placementID model.RepoID) (nativemirror.NativeMirror, error) {
219		if err := s.admitCreate(primary); err != nil {
220			return nativemirror.NativeMirror{}, err
221		}
222	
223		caps := s.Server.JurisdictionCaps()
224		if caps == nil || s.clusters == nil || s.intents == nil {
225			return nativemirror.NativeMirror{}, unavailable("native mirroring is not configured")
226		}
227	
228		// Rooted-expansion capability fence (ADR 20260724-rsl-root-of-trust-mvp).
229		// Once a repo is rooted, adding a placement means publishing that placement
230		// into the existing root of trust, which requires the placement-acceptance
231		// capability (slice 4). This is the capability check, not a lifecycle state or
232		// a path allowlist: it reads the primary's trust state and, if rooted, probes
233		// the target for mixed-version safety. It is only the outer gate; the actual
234		// A->B expansion create is still fenced deeper in CreateWithGroupLock until a
235		// later slice 4 PR wires it (rot-implementation-plan, slice 4, PR 12).
236		rootedExpansion, err := s.enforceRootedExpansionCapability(ctx, primaryID, primary.placement.ClusterSlug, clusterSlug)
237		if err != nil {
238			return nativemirror.NativeMirror{}, err
239		}
240	
241		// Decision 9a: every target check is read-only and precedes group minting
242		// and the native_mirrors insert.
243		target, err := checkNativeMirrorTarget(ctx, s.clusters, clusterSlug, primary.placement.ClusterSlug, primary.placement.Jurisdiction)
244		if err != nil {
245			return nativemirror.NativeMirror{}, err
246		}
247	
248		home, err := s.clusters.GetBySlugGlobal(ctx, primary.placement.ClusterSlug)
249		if err != nil {
250			slogutil.Error(ctx, "native-mirror primary cluster lookup failed",
251				slog.String("cluster_slug", primary.placement.ClusterSlug), slog.Any("error", err))
252			return nativemirror.NativeMirror{}, internalErr()
253		}
254		primaryURL, err := joinPublicRepoURL(home.PublicURL, primary.placement.URL)
255		if err != nil {
256			slogutil.Error(ctx, "native-mirror primary URL is unusable",
257				slog.String("repo_id", primaryID.String()), slog.Any("error", err))
258			return nativemirror.NativeMirror{}, internalErr()
259		}
260	
261		// Step 0: activate the native group on the primary data plane. Both calls
262		// are idempotent, so a retry after either half succeeds converges safely.
263		project, err := caps.Resource.GetProject(ctx, primary.placement.OwningProjectID)
264		if err != nil {
265			slogutil.Error(ctx, "native-mirror primary project lookup failed", slog.Any("error", err))

14	// RequestStatus is the processing state of a native-mirror request.

20		RequestFailed     RequestStatus = "failed"

27	// Request is one native_mirror_requests row: a native-mirror region that has

29	type Request struct {
30		RepoID             model.RepoID
31		ClusterSlug        string
32		PlacementID        model.RepoID
33		Jurisdiction       string
34		CreatedByAccountID string

70	       status, attempts, COALESCE(last_error, ''), COALESCE(failure_code, ''), COALESCE(failure_message, ''),
71	       next_publish_at, failed_at, cancelled_at, COALESCE(cancelled_by_account_id, ''), cancel_settled_at, created_at`

73	func scanRequest(s rowScanner) (Request, error) {
74		var r Request
75		var repoID, placementID, status string
76		if err := s.Scan(&repoID, &r.ClusterSlug, &placementID, &r.Jurisdiction, &r.CreatedByAccountID,
77			&status, &r.Attempts, &r.LastError, &r.FailureCode, &r.FailureMessage,
78			&r.NextPublishAt, &r.FailedAt, &r.CancelledAt, &r.CancelledByAccountID, &r.CancelSettledAt, &r.CreatedAt); err != nil {
79			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("scan native mirror request: %w", err)

84		}

92	type requestQuerier interface {
93		Query(ctx context.Context, sql string, args ...any) (pgx.Rows, error)
94	}
95	
96	func queryRequests(ctx context.Context, q requestQuerier, sql string, args ...any) ([]Request, error) {
97		rows, err := q.Query(ctx, sql, args...)
98		if err != nil {
99			return nil, fmt.Errorf("native mirror requests: %w", err)
100		}
101		defer rows.Close()
102		var out []Request
103		for rows.Next() {
104			r, err := scanRequest(rows)
105			if err != nil {
106				return nil, err
107			}
108			out = append(out, r)
109		}
110		if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
111			return nil, fmt.Errorf("native mirror requests: %w", err)
112		}
113		return out, nil
114	}

116	// firstRequest returns the only row of a single-row statement.
117	func firstRequest(ctx context.Context, q requestQuerier, sql string, args ...any) (Request, bool, error) {
118		rows, err := queryRequests(ctx, q, sql, args...)
119		if err != nil || len(rows) == 0 {
120			return Request{}, false, err
121		}
122		return rows[0], true, nil
123	}

125	// RecordRequests stores the native-mirror regions a repo create asked for and
126	// returns their rows, each with its reserved placement id. jurisdiction is
127	// the primary's, whose regional core runs the jobs. The repo is not active
128	// yet, so nothing is published: PublishRepoRequests does that once it is, and
129	// the sweep publishes after publishAfter if that never happens. A repeated
130	// slug keeps its row.
131	func (s *Service) RecordRequests(ctx context.Context, repoID model.RepoID, jurisdiction string, createdBy model.AccountID, clusterSlugs []string, publishAfter time.Duration) ([]Request, error) {
132		var creator *string
133		if createdBy != "" {
134			v := createdBy.String()
135			creator = &v
136		}
137		placementIDs := make([]string, len(clusterSlugs))
138		for i := range clusterSlugs {
139			placementIDs[i] = model.NewRepoID().String()
140		}
141		if _, err := s.pool.Exec(ctx,
142			`INSERT INTO native_mirror_requests
143			     (repo_id, cluster_slug, placement_id, jurisdiction, created_by_account_id, next_publish_at)
144			 SELECT $1, slug, pid, $2, $3, now() + ($6::INT8 * INTERVAL '1 microsecond')
145			 FROM unnest($4::TEXT[], $5::TEXT[]) AS r(slug, pid)
146			 ON CONFLICT (repo_id, cluster_slug) DO NOTHING`,
147			repoID.String(), jurisdiction, creator, clusterSlugs, placementIDs, publishAfter.Microseconds()); err != nil {
148			return nil, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: record requests for %s: %w", repoID, err)
149		}
150		requests, err := queryRequests(ctx, s.pool,
151			`SELECT `+requestColumns+` FROM native_mirror_requests
152			 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cluster_slug = ANY($2::TEXT[]) ORDER BY cluster_slug`,
153			repoID.String(), clusterSlugs)
154		if err != nil {
155			return nil, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: read recorded requests for %s: %w", repoID, err)
156		}
157		return requests, nil
158	}

160	// SubmitRequest stores a request for one region and returns it. A failed or
161	// cancelled request for the same region is reset; this is how a user retries.
162	// A live request keeps its placement id. The caller publishes the job with
163	// PublishRequest after this returns, so a consumer never sees the job before
164	// the row is committed.
165	func (s *Service) SubmitRequest(ctx context.Context, p SubmitRequestParams) (Request, error) {
166		var creator *string
167		if p.CreatedBy != "" {
168			v := p.CreatedBy.String()
169			creator = &v
170		}
171		// A row whose job is running stays processing. Its outcome, not this
172		// submit, decides what happens next.
173		req, found, err := firstRequest(ctx, s.pool,
174			`INSERT INTO native_mirror_requests
175			     (repo_id, cluster_slug, placement_id, jurisdiction, created_by_account_id, next_publish_at)
176			 VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, now() + ($6::INT8 * INTERVAL '1 microsecond'))
177			 ON CONFLICT (repo_id, cluster_slug) DO UPDATE SET
178			     status = CASE
179			         WHEN native_mirror_requests.status = 'processing' AND native_mirror_requests.cancelled_at IS NULL
180			         THEN 'processing' ELSE 'pending' END,
181			     created_at = CASE
182			         WHEN native_mirror_requests.failed_at IS NOT NULL OR native_mirror_requests.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL
183			         THEN now() ELSE native_mirror_requests.created_at END,
184			     created_by_account_id = CASE
185			         WHEN native_mirror_requests.failed_at IS NOT NULL OR native_mirror_requests.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL
186			         THEN excluded.created_by_account_id ELSE native_mirror_requests.created_by_account_id END,
187			     failed_at = NULL,
188			     cancelled_at = NULL,
189			     cancelled_by_account_id = NULL,
190			     cancel_settled_at = NULL,
191			     failure_code = NULL,
192			     failure_message = NULL,
193			     next_publish_at = excluded.next_publish_at
194			 RETURNING `+requestColumns,
195			p.RepoID.String(), p.ClusterSlug, model.NewRepoID().String(), p.Jurisdiction, creator, RequestPublishHold.Microseconds())
196		if err == nil && !found {
197			err = errors.New("upsert returned no row")
198		}
199		if err != nil {
200			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: submit request %s/%s: %w", p.RepoID, p.ClusterSlug, err)
201		}
202		return req, nil
203	}

205	// PublishRequest publishes the job of a request that SubmitRequest stored.
206	// When the publish fails, the request is rescheduled so the sweep publishes
207	// it within a minute, and the error is returned for logging.
208	func (s *Service) PublishRequest(ctx context.Context, req Request, publisher RequestPublisher) error {
209		return s.publishClaimed(ctx, []Request{req}, publisher)
210	}
211	
212	// PublishRepoRequests publishes the job of each pending request of repoID.
213	// Repo create calls it once the repo is active. A request whose publish fails
214	// is left for the sweep, and the first such error is returned.
215	func (s *Service) PublishRepoRequests(ctx context.Context, repoID model.RepoID, publisher RequestPublisher) error {
216		claimed, err := queryRequests(ctx, s.pool,
217			`UPDATE native_mirror_requests
218			 SET next_publish_at = now() + ($2::INT8 * INTERVAL '1 microsecond')
219			 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND status = 'pending' AND failed_at IS NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL
220			 RETURNING `+requestColumns,
221			repoID.String(), RequestPublishHold.Microseconds())
222		if err != nil {
223			return fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: claim requests of %s to publish: %w", repoID, err)
224		}
225		return s.publishClaimed(ctx, claimed, publisher)
226	}

228	// PublishDueRequests publishes up to limit requests in jurisdiction whose
229	// publish is due: a lost job, a wait that ended, or a repo the provisioning
230	// reconciler activated. It returns how many it published.
231	func (s *Service) PublishDueRequests(ctx context.Context, jurisdiction string, limit int, publisher RequestPublisher) (int, error) {
232		claimed, err := s.claimDue(ctx, jurisdiction, limit, false, RequestPublishHold)
233		if err != nil {
234			return 0, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: claim due requests in %s: %w", jurisdiction, err)
235		}
236		return len(claimed), s.publishClaimed(ctx, claimed, publisher)
237	}
238	
239	// claimDue claims up to limit open requests in jurisdiction whose
240	// next_publish_at has passed, either failed ones or the rest, and pushes their
241	// next_publish_at forward by hold so no other pod claims them meanwhile. SKIP
242	// LOCKED gives concurrent sweeps disjoint batches, as in created_outbox.go.
243	func (s *Service) claimDue(ctx context.Context, jurisdiction string, limit int, failed bool, hold time.Duration) ([]Request, error) {
244		failedCond := "failed_at IS NULL AND cancel_settled_at IS NULL"
245		if failed {
246			failedCond = "failed_at IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL"
247		}
248		claimed, err := queryRequests(ctx, s.pool,
249			`UPDATE native_mirror_requests
250			 SET next_publish_at = now() + ($3::INT8 * INTERVAL '1 microsecond')
251			 WHERE (repo_id, cluster_slug) IN (
252			     SELECT repo_id, cluster_slug FROM native_mirror_requests
253			     WHERE jurisdiction = $1 AND `+failedCond+` AND next_publish_at <= now()
254			     ORDER BY next_publish_at LIMIT $2
255			     FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
256			   AND `+failedCond+` AND next_publish_at <= now()
257			 RETURNING `+requestColumns,
258			jurisdiction, limit, hold.Microseconds())
259		return claimed, err
260	}
261	
262	// requestPublishRetry is when the sweep tries again after a failed publish.
263	const requestPublishRetry = time.Minute
264	
265	// publishClaimed tries every claimed request, so one failure does not hold
266	// back the rest for a whole RequestPublishHold.
267	func (s *Service) publishClaimed(ctx context.Context, claimed []Request, publisher RequestPublisher) error {
268		var errs []error
269		for _, req := range claimed {
270			err := publisher.PublishRequest(ctx, req)
271			if err == nil {
272				continue
273			}
274			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: publish request %s/%s: %w", req.RepoID, req.ClusterSlug, err))
275			// Match the publish time this claim set. A resubmit or a wait since the
276			// claim set a new one, and its hold must stand.
277			if _, err := s.pool.Exec(ctx,
278				`UPDATE native_mirror_requests SET next_publish_at = now() + ($3::INT8 * INTERVAL '1 microsecond')
279				 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cluster_slug = $2 AND placement_id = $4 AND next_publish_at = $5`,
280				req.RepoID.String(), req.ClusterSlug, requestPublishRetry.Microseconds(), req.PlacementID.String(), req.NextPublishAt); err != nil {
281				errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: reschedule request %s/%s: %w", req.RepoID, req.ClusterSlug, err))
282			}
283		}
284		return errors.Join(errs...)
285	}
286	
287	// StartRequestAttempt marks a live request as processing and returns it with
288	// its new attempt number. A cancelled request whose removal is not settled
289	// still starts, so its job can remove the intent. started is false when the
290	// request is failed, settled, or gone, so the job has nothing to do.
291	func (s *Service) StartRequestAttempt(ctx context.Context, repoID model.RepoID, clusterSlug string) (Request, bool, error) {
292		req, found, err := firstRequest(ctx, s.pool,
293			`UPDATE native_mirror_requests SET status = 'processing', attempts = attempts + 1
294			 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cluster_slug = $2 AND failed_at IS NULL AND cancel_settled_at IS NULL
295			 RETURNING `+requestColumns,
296			repoID.String(), clusterSlug)
297		if err != nil {
298			return Request{}, false, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: start request attempt %s/%s: %w", repoID, clusterSlug, err)
299		}
300		return req, found, nil
301	}
302	
303	// sqlFragment is SQL that fencedUpdate splices into a statement. Only an
304	// untyped string constant converts to it implicitly, so a string variable
305	// holding user data does not compile as one.
306	type sqlFragment string
307	
308	// fencedUpdate applies set to the request only while attempt is still its
309	// current processing attempt. It reports whether it did. Every value goes in
310	// args as a bind parameter from $4 on.
311	func (s *Service) fencedUpdate(ctx context.Context, op string, req Request, set sqlFragment, args ...any) (bool, error) {
312		all := append([]any{req.RepoID.String(), req.ClusterSlug, req.Attempts}, args...)
313		tag, err := s.pool.Exec(ctx,
314			`UPDATE native_mirror_requests SET `+string(set)+`
315			 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cluster_slug = $2 AND attempts = $3 AND status = 'processing'
316			   AND failed_at IS NULL AND cancel_settled_at IS NULL`, all...)
317		if err != nil {
318			return false, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: %s %s/%s: %w", op, req.RepoID, req.ClusterSlug, err)
319		}
320		return tag.RowsAffected() == 1, nil
321	}
322	
323	// FinishRequest deletes the request attempt req ran, once its intent exists,
324	// unless the request was cancelled. The delete is fenced on req's attempt and
325	// placement id, so an attempt that finishes late never removes a newer
326	// request for the same region; that request's own job finishes it. cancelled
327	// is true when req's request is still there and cancelled, so the caller must
328	// remove the intent and call SettleCancelledRequest.
329	func (s *Service) FinishRequest(ctx context.Context, req Request) (Request, bool, error) {
330		tag, err := s.pool.Exec(ctx,
331			`DELETE FROM native_mirror_requests
332			 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cluster_slug = $2 AND placement_id = $3 AND attempts = $4 AND cancelled_at IS NULL`,
333			req.RepoID.String(), req.ClusterSlug, req.PlacementID.String(), req.Attempts)
334		if err != nil {
335			return Request{}, false, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: finish request %s/%s: %w", req.RepoID, req.ClusterSlug, err)
336		}
337		if tag.RowsAffected() == 1 {
338			return Request{}, false, nil
339		}
340		current, found, err := firstRequest(ctx, s.pool,
341			`SELECT `+requestColumns+` FROM native_mirror_requests WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cluster_slug = $2`,
342			req.RepoID.String(), req.ClusterSlug)
343		if err != nil {
344			return Request{}, false, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: read finished request %s/%s: %w", req.RepoID, req.ClusterSlug, err)
345		}
346		return current, found && current.CancelledAt != nil && current.PlacementID == req.PlacementID, nil
347	}
348	
349	// SettleCancelledRequest records that the job of a cancelled request removed
350	// any intent it created, so the request is no longer run and can be purged.
351	// It reports false when the request is no longer cancelled, because a user
352	// asked for the region again.
353	//
354	// status goes back to pending only to say no job holds the row; there is no
355	// settled status. cancel_settled_at alone keeps the row from running again:
356	// claimDue, StartRequestAttempt and the fenced updates all require it to be
357	// NULL, and PublishRepoRequests requires cancelled_at to be NULL.
358	func (s *Service) SettleCancelledRequest(ctx context.Context, repoID model.RepoID, clusterSlug string) (bool, error) {
359		tag, err := s.pool.Exec(ctx,
360			`UPDATE native_mirror_requests SET cancel_settled_at = now(), status = 'pending'
361			 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cluster_slug = $2 AND cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND cancel_settled_at IS NULL`,
362			repoID.String(), clusterSlug)
363		if err != nil {
364			return false, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: settle cancelled request %s/%s: %w", repoID, clusterSlug, err)
365		}
366		return tag.RowsAffected() == 1, nil
367	}
368	
369	// CurrentRequest returns the request as stored now. found is false when the
370	// row is gone.
371	func (s *Service) CurrentRequest(ctx context.Context, repoID model.RepoID, clusterSlug string) (Request, bool, error) {
372		req, found, err := firstRequest(ctx, s.pool,
373			`SELECT `+requestColumns+` FROM native_mirror_requests WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cluster_slug = $2`,
374			repoID.String(), clusterSlug)
375		if err != nil {
376			return Request{}, false, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: read request %s/%s: %w", repoID, clusterSlug, err)
377		}
378		return req, found, nil
379	}
380	
381	// RecordRequestRetry returns the attempt to pending while JetStream redelivers
382	// its job.
383	func (s *Service) RecordRequestRetry(ctx context.Context, req Request, lastError string) (bool, error) {
384		return s.fencedUpdate(ctx, "record request retry", req, `status = 'pending', last_error = $4`, lastError)
385	}
386	
387	// RecordRequestWait returns the attempt to pending and lets the sweep publish
388	// the job again after wait. Waits that end on their own, such as a primary
389	// that is still provisioning, use this instead of JetStream redelivery.
390	func (s *Service) RecordRequestWait(ctx context.Context, req Request, lastError string, wait time.Duration) (bool, error) {
391		return s.fencedUpdate(ctx, "record request wait", req,
392			`status = 'pending', last_error = $4, next_publish_at = now() + ($5::INT8 * INTERVAL '1 microsecond')`,
393			lastError, wait.Microseconds())
394	}
395	
396	// requestFailedRecheck is how often the sweep checks that a failed request's
397	// repo still exists.
398	const requestFailedRecheck = time.Hour
399	
400	// RecordRequestFailure marks a request that cannot succeed. code and message
401	// are shown to users; lastError is for operators. The row stays so the repo
402	// shows the region as failed.
403	func (s *Service) RecordRequestFailure(ctx context.Context, req Request, code, message, lastError string) (bool, error) {
404		if code == "" || message == "" {
405			return false, errors.New("nativemirror: failure code and message are required")
406		}
407		return s.fencedUpdate(ctx, "record request failure", req,
408			`status = 'failed', failed_at = now(), failure_code = $4, failure_message = $5, last_error = $6,
409			 next_publish_at = now() + ($7::INT8 * INTERVAL '1 microsecond')`,
410			code, message, lastError, requestFailedRecheck.Microseconds())
411	}
412	
413	// ListRequests returns the repo's requests that are not cancelled, ordered by
414	// cluster.
415	func (s *Service) ListRequests(ctx context.Context, repoID model.RepoID) ([]Request, error) {
416		requests, err := queryRequests(ctx, s.pool,
417			`SELECT `+requestColumns+` FROM native_mirror_requests
418			 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cancelled_at IS NULL ORDER BY cluster_slug`, repoID.String())
419		if err != nil {
420			return nil, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: list requests for %s: %w", repoID, err)
421		}
422		return requests, nil
423	}
424	
425	// CancelRequest marks an open request as cancelled by cancelledBy and returns
426	// it. found is false when there was no open request. The cancel queues the
427	// row at once, so its job removes any intent and settles it; a failed request
428	// is cleared first, so it does not stay stranded where no job runs.
429	func (s *Service) CancelRequest(ctx context.Context, repoID model.RepoID, clusterSlug string, cancelledBy model.AccountID) (Request, bool, error) {
430		req, found, err := firstRequest(ctx, s.pool,
431			`UPDATE native_mirror_requests SET cancelled_at = now(), cancelled_by_account_id = NULLIF($3, ''),
432			     failed_at = NULL, status = CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 'pending' ELSE status END,
433			     next_publish_at = now()
434			 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cluster_slug = $2 AND cancelled_at IS NULL
435			 RETURNING `+requestColumns,
436			repoID.String(), clusterSlug, string(cancelledBy))
437		if err != nil {
438			return Request{}, false, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: cancel request %s/%s: %w", repoID, clusterSlug, err)
439		}
440		return req, found, nil
441	}
442	
443	// DeleteRequest removes one request, cancelled or not, and returns it. found
444	// is false when there was none.
445	func (s *Service) DeleteRequest(ctx context.Context, repoID model.RepoID, clusterSlug string) (Request, bool, error) {
446		req, found, err := firstRequest(ctx, s.pool,
447			`DELETE FROM native_mirror_requests WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cluster_slug = $2
448			 RETURNING `+requestColumns,
449			repoID.String(), clusterSlug)
450		if err != nil {
451			return Request{}, false, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: delete request %s/%s: %w", repoID, clusterSlug, err)
452		}
453		return req, found, nil
454	}
455	
456	// PurgeCancelledRequests deletes cancelled requests in jurisdiction whose
457	// removal settled more than olderThan ago. olderThan must exceed the longest
458	// job attempt: an attempt that started before the cancel reads the row when
459	// it finishes, and removes the intent it created.
460	func (s *Service) PurgeCancelledRequests(ctx context.Context, jurisdiction string, olderThan time.Duration) error {
461		_, err := s.pool.Exec(ctx,
462			`DELETE FROM native_mirror_requests
463			 WHERE jurisdiction = $1 AND cancel_settled_at < now() - ($2::INT8 * INTERVAL '1 microsecond')`,
464			jurisdiction, olderThan.Microseconds())
465		if err != nil {
466			return fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: purge cancelled requests in %s: %w", jurisdiction, err)
467		}
468		return nil
469	}
470	
471	// OldestOpenRequestAgeSeconds returns the age of the oldest request in
472	// jurisdiction that is neither failed nor cancelled, or zero when none is.
473	func (s *Service) OldestOpenRequestAgeSeconds(ctx context.Context, jurisdiction string) (int64, error) {
474		var age int64
475		err := s.pool.QueryRow(ctx,
476			`SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - min(created_at))::INT8, 0)
477			 FROM native_mirror_requests
478			 WHERE jurisdiction = $1 AND failed_at IS NULL AND cancel_settled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL`,
479			jurisdiction).Scan(&age)
480		if err != nil {
481			return 0, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: oldest open request in %s: %w", jurisdiction, err)
482		}
483		return age, nil
484	}
485	
486	// ClaimFailedRequestsForCheck returns up to limit failed requests in
487	// jurisdiction that are due for a check that their repo still exists, and
488	// pushes their next check back by an hour. Publishing never picks failed
489	// rows, so next_publish_at is free to schedule this check.
490	func (s *Service) ClaimFailedRequestsForCheck(ctx context.Context, jurisdiction string, limit int) ([]Request, error) {
491		claimed, err := s.claimDue(ctx, jurisdiction, limit, true, requestFailedRecheck)
492		if err != nil {
493			return nil, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: claim failed requests in %s: %w", jurisdiction, err)
494		}
495		return claimed, nil
496	}

1	package nativemirrorcreate
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"log/slog"
8		"runtime/debug"
9		"time"
10	
11		"github.com/entireio/go-nuts/backoff"
12		"github.com/entireio/go-nuts/jsconsumer"
13		"github.com/entireio/go-nuts/natsmsg"
14		"github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
15		"github.com/nats-io/nats.go/jetstream"
16		"go.opentelemetry.io/otel"
17		"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/attribute"
18		"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace"
19	
20		"entire.io/core/coreapi"
21		"entire.io/core/model"
22		"entire.io/core/nativemirror"
23		"entire.io/internal/entirecore/repoops"
24		"entire.io/slogutil"
25	)
26	
27	const (
28		ackWait           = 2 * time.Minute
29		maxDeliver        = 5
30		attemptTimeout    = 90 * time.Second
31		durableNamePrefix = "entirecore-native-mirror-create-"
32		dlqSubjectPrefix  = "repo.ops.dlq.v1.native_mirror_create."
33		// exhaustedWait is when the sweep publishes a job again after its
34		// JetStream deliveries ran out on retryable errors. The runner fails the
35		// request once it has kept failing for a day.
36		exhaustedWait = 10 * time.Minute
37	)
38	
39	// retryPolicy spaces redeliveries 30 s, 1 min, 2 min, then 4 min apart.
40	var retryPolicy = backoff.Policy{NakDelay: 30 * time.Second, Factor: 2, MaxDelay: 4 * time.Minute, MaxDeliver: maxDeliver}
41	
42	// RequestStore is the request state the consumer changes.
43	type RequestStore interface {
44		StartRequestAttempt(ctx context.Context, repoID model.RepoID, clusterSlug string) (nativemirror.Request, bool, error)
45		RecordRequestRetry(ctx context.Context, req nativemirror.Request, lastError string) (bool, error)
46		RecordRequestWait(ctx context.Context, req nativemirror.Request, lastError string, wait time.Duration) (bool, error)
47		RecordRequestFailure(ctx context.Context, req nativemirror.Request, code, message, lastError string) (bool, error)
48	}
49	
50	// Runner makes one attempt at a request.
51	type Runner interface {
52		Run(ctx context.Context, req nativemirror.Request) coreapi.NativeMirrorRequestOutcome
53	}
54	
55	// Config contains the consumer dependencies.
56	type Config struct {
57		Conn         *nats.Conn
58		Store        RequestStore
59		Runner       Runner
60		DLQ          natsmsg.DLQPublisher
61		Jurisdiction string
62	}
63	
64	// Consumer drains native_mirror_create jobs for one jurisdiction.
65	type Consumer struct {
66		cfg Config
67	}
68	
69	// New validates cfg and returns a Consumer.
70	func New(cfg Config) (*Consumer, error) {
71		switch {
72		case cfg.Conn == nil:
73			return nil, errors.New("nativemirrorcreate: Conn is required")
74		case cfg.Store == nil:
75			return nil, errors.New("nativemirrorcreate: Store is required")
76		case cfg.Runner == nil:
77			return nil, errors.New("nativemirrorcreate: Runner is required")
78		case cfg.DLQ == nil:
79			return nil, errors.New("nativemirrorcreate: DLQ is required")
80		case cfg.Jurisdiction == "":
81			return nil, errors.New("nativemirrorcreate: Jurisdiction is required")
82		}
83		return &Consumer{cfg: cfg}, nil
84	}
85	
86	// Run consumes jobs until ctx is cancelled.
87	func (c *Consumer) Run(ctx context.Context) {
88		err := jsconsumer.Run(ctx, c.cfg.Conn, jsconsumer.Config{
89			Name:           "native-mirror-create",
90			Stream:         repoops.StreamName,
91			Durable:        durableNamePrefix + c.cfg.Jurisdiction,
92			FilterSubject:  subjectFilter(c.cfg.Jurisdiction),
93			AckWait:        ackWait,
94			MaxDeliver:     maxDeliver,
95			MaxMessages:    1,
96			KeepInProgress: true,
97		}, func(ctx context.Context, msg jetstream.Msg) {
98			c.handleMessage(ctx, msg)
99		})
100		if err != nil {
101			slogutil.Error(ctx, "native-mirror-create consumer stopped", slog.String("error", err.Error()))
102		}
103	}
104	
105	func (c *Consumer) handleMessage(ctx context.Context, msg jetstream.Msg) {
106		ctx = natsmsg.ExtractHeader(ctx, msg.Headers())
107		stopHeartbeat := natsmsg.KeepInProgress(msg.InProgress, ackWait)
108		defer stopHeartbeat()
109		defer func() {
110			if recovered := recover(); recovered != nil {
111				slogutil.Error(ctx, "native-mirror-create delivery panicked",
112					slog.Any("panic", recovered), slog.String("stack", string(debug.Stack())))
113				c.nak(ctx, msg, fmt.Errorf("native-mirror-create delivery panicked: %v", recovered))
114			}
115		}()
116	
117		parsed, err := repoops.ParseSubject(msg.Subject())
118		if err != nil {
119			c.deadLetterAndAck(ctx, msg, "bad_subject", err)
120			return
121		}
122		j, repoID, err := unmarshalJob(msg.Data())
123		if err != nil {
124			c.deadLetterAndAck(ctx, msg, "bad_payload", err)
125			return
126		}
127		if parsed.Placement.Jurisdiction != c.cfg.Jurisdiction || parsed.Placement.ClusterSlug != j.ClusterSlug {
128			c.deadLetterAndAck(ctx, msg, "route_mismatch", fmt.Errorf(
129				"subject %s does not route job for %s/%s in %s", msg.Subject(), repoID, j.ClusterSlug, c.cfg.Jurisdiction))
130			return
131		}
132	
133		req, started, err := c.cfg.Store.StartRequestAttempt(ctx, repoID, j.ClusterSlug)
134		if err != nil {
135			c.nak(ctx, msg, err)
136			return
137		}
138		if !started {
139			// Failed, cancelled, or already done: nothing is left to run.
140			c.ack(ctx, msg)
141			return
142		}
143		if req.Jurisdiction != c.cfg.Jurisdiction {
144			c.deadLetterAndAck(ctx, msg, "route_mismatch", fmt.Errorf(
145				"request %s/%s belongs to %s, consumer is %s", repoID, j.ClusterSlug, req.Jurisdiction, c.cfg.Jurisdiction))
146			return
147		}
148		c.execute(ctx, msg, req)
149	}
150	
151	func (c *Consumer) execute(ctx context.Context, msg jetstream.Msg, req nativemirror.Request) {
152		ctx, span := otel.Tracer("entire.io/internal/entirecore/nativemirrorcreate").Start(ctx, "native-mirror-create.execute",
153			trace.WithSpanKind(trace.SpanKindConsumer),
154			trace.WithAttributes(
155				attribute.String("repo_id", req.RepoID.String()),
156				attribute.String("cluster_slug", req.ClusterSlug),
157				attribute.String("placement_id", req.PlacementID.String()),
158				attribute.Int64("attempt", req.Attempts),
159				attribute.String("messaging.destination.name", msg.Subject()),
160			),
161		)
162		startedAt := time.Now()
163		outcome := c.run(ctx, req)
164		kind := string(outcome.Kind)
165		defer func() {
166			span.SetAttributes(attribute.String("native_mirror_request.outcome", kind))
167			recordExecution(ctx, c.cfg.Jurisdiction, kind, outcome.Code, time.Since(startedAt))
168			span.End()
169		}()
170		if outcome.Err != nil {
171			span.RecordError(outcome.Err)
172		}
173	
174		var (
175			applied bool
176			err     error
177		)
178		switch outcome.Kind {
179		case coreapi.NativeMirrorRequestDone, coreapi.NativeMirrorRequestDropped:
180			c.ack(ctx, msg)
181			return
182		case coreapi.NativeMirrorRequestFail:
183			applied, err = c.cfg.Store.RecordRequestFailure(ctx, req, outcome.Code, outcome.Message, errText(outcome.Err))
184		case coreapi.NativeMirrorRequestWait:
185			applied, err = c.cfg.Store.RecordRequestWait(ctx, req, errText(outcome.Err), outcome.Wait)
186		case coreapi.NativeMirrorRequestRetry:
187			if backoff.IsFinalDelivery(msg, maxDeliver) {
188				kind = "exhausted"
189				applied, err = c.cfg.Store.RecordRequestWait(ctx, req, errText(outcome.Err), exhaustedWait)
190				break
191			}
192			applied, err = c.cfg.Store.RecordRequestRetry(ctx, req, errText(outcome.Err))
193			if err == nil && applied {
194				c.nak(ctx, msg, outcome.Err)
195				return
196			}
197		default:
198			c.nak(ctx, msg, fmt.Errorf("unknown native-mirror request outcome %q", outcome.Kind))
199			return
200		}
201		if err != nil {
202			c.nak(ctx, msg, fmt.Errorf("record %s outcome: %w", kind, err))
203			return
204		}
205		if !applied {
206			// A newer attempt, a cancel, or a retry reset owns the row now.
207			kind = "superseded"
208		}
209		c.ack(ctx, msg)
210	}
211	
212	func (c *Consumer) run(ctx context.Context, req nativemirror.Request) (outcome coreapi.NativeMirrorRequestOutcome) {
213		defer func() {
214			if recovered := recover(); recovered != nil {
215				slogutil.Error(ctx, "native-mirror-create runner panicked",
216					slog.Any("panic", recovered), slog.String("stack", string(debug.Stack())))
217				outcome = coreapi.NativeMirrorRequestOutcome{Kind: coreapi.NativeMirrorRequestRetry, Err: fmt.Errorf("runner panicked: %v", recovered)}
218			}
219		}()
220		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, attemptTimeout)
221		defer cancel()
222		return c.cfg.Runner.Run(ctx, req)
223	}
224	
225	func errText(err error) string {
226		if err == nil {
227			return ""
228		}
229		return err.Error()
230	}
231	
232	func (c *Consumer) deadLetterAndAck(ctx context.Context, msg jetstream.Msg, reason string, cause error) {
233		if err := natsmsg.DeadLetter(ctx, c.cfg.DLQ, dlqSubjectPrefix+natsmsg.SubjectToken(reason), msg, reason); err != nil {
234			c.nak(ctx, msg, errors.Join(cause, err))
235			return
236		}
237		c.ack(ctx, msg)
238	}
239	
240	func (c *Consumer) ack(ctx context.Context, msg jetstream.Msg) {
241		if err := msg.Ack(); err != nil {
242			slogutil.Warn(ctx, "native-mirror-create ack failed", slog.String("error", err.Error()))
243		}
244	}
245	
246	func (c *Consumer) nak(ctx context.Context, msg jetstream.Msg, cause error) {
247		delay := retryPolicy.DelayFor(backoff.NumDelivered(msg))
248		slogutil.Warn(ctx, "native-mirror-create job failed; will retry",
249			slog.Duration("delay", delay), slog.String("error", errText(cause)))
250		if err := msg.NakWithDelay(delay); err != nil {
251			slogutil.Warn(ctx, "native-mirror-create nak failed", slog.String("error", err.Error()))
252		}
253	}

1	package nativemirror
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"time"
8	
9		"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
10	
11		"entire.io/core/model"
12	)
13	
14	// RequestStatus is the processing state of a native-mirror request.
15	type RequestStatus string
16	
17	const (
18		RequestPending    RequestStatus = "pending"
19		RequestProcessing RequestStatus = "processing"
20		RequestFailed     RequestStatus = "failed"
21	)
22	
23	// RequestPublishHold is how long a publish holds off the sweep. It exceeds a
24	// job's whole JetStream retry chain, so the sweep republishes only a lost job.
25	const RequestPublishHold = 30 * time.Minute
26	
27	// Request is one native_mirror_requests row: a native-mirror region that has
28	// no native_mirrors intent yet.
29	type Request struct {
30		RepoID             model.RepoID
31		ClusterSlug        string
32		PlacementID        model.RepoID
33		Jurisdiction       string
34		CreatedByAccountID string
35		Status             RequestStatus
36		Attempts           int64
37		LastError          string
38		FailureCode        string
39		FailureMessage     string
40		NextPublishAt      time.Time
41		FailedAt           *time.Time
42		// CancelledAt is set when a user removed the region before its intent
43		// existed. A job that was already running reads it back when it finishes,
44		// and deletes the intent it just created.
45		CancelledAt *time.Time
46		// CancelledByAccountID is the account that cancelled the request, or
47		// empty.
48		CancelledByAccountID string
49		// CancelSettledAt is set once the job of a cancelled request has removed
50		// any intent stored under PlacementID.
51		CancelSettledAt *time.Time
52		CreatedAt       time.Time
53	}
54	
55	// RequestPublisher queues a native_mirror_create job for a request and returns
56	// nil once the broker has accepted it.
57	type RequestPublisher interface {
58		PublishRequest(ctx context.Context, request Request) error
59	}
60	
61	// SubmitRequestParams are the values a POST /native-mirrors stores.
62	type SubmitRequestParams struct {
63		RepoID       model.RepoID
64		ClusterSlug  string
65		Jurisdiction string
66		CreatedBy    model.AccountID
67	}
68	
69	const requestColumns = `repo_id, cluster_slug, placement_id, jurisdiction, COALESCE(created_by_account_id, ''),
70	       status, attempts, COALESCE(last_error, ''), COALESCE(failure_code, ''), COALESCE(failure_message, ''),
71	       next_publish_at, failed_at, cancelled_at, COALESCE(cancelled_by_account_id, ''), cancel_settled_at, created_at`
72	
73	func scanRequest(s rowScanner) (Request, error) {
74		var r Request
75		var repoID, placementID, status string
76		if err := s.Scan(&repoID, &r.ClusterSlug, &placementID, &r.Jurisdiction, &r.CreatedByAccountID,
77			&status, &r.Attempts, &r.LastError, &r.FailureCode, &r.FailureMessage,
78			&r.NextPublishAt, &r.FailedAt, &r.CancelledAt, &r.CancelledByAccountID, &r.CancelSettledAt, &r.CreatedAt); err != nil {
79			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("scan native mirror request: %w", err)
80		}
81		var err error
82		if r.RepoID, err = model.ParseRepoID(repoID); err != nil {
83			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("scan native mirror request: %w", err)
84		}
85		if r.PlacementID, err = model.ParseRepoID(placementID); err != nil {
86			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("scan native mirror request placement: %w", err)
87		}
88		r.Status = RequestStatus(status)
89		return r, nil
90	}
91	
92	type requestQuerier interface {
93		Query(ctx context.Context, sql string, args ...any) (pgx.Rows, error)
94	}
95	
96	func queryRequests(ctx context.Context, q requestQuerier, sql string, args ...any) ([]Request, error) {
97		rows, err := q.Query(ctx, sql, args...)
98		if err != nil {
99			return nil, fmt.Errorf("native mirror requests: %w", err)
100		}
101		defer rows.Close()
102		var out []Request
103		for rows.Next() {
104			r, err := scanRequest(rows)
105			if err != nil {
106				return nil, err
107			}
108			out = append(out, r)
109		}
110		if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
111			return nil, fmt.Errorf("native mirror requests: %w", err)
112		}
113		return out, nil
114	}
115	
116	// firstRequest returns the only row of a single-row statement.
117	func firstRequest(ctx context.Context, q requestQuerier, sql string, args ...any) (Request, bool, error) {
118		rows, err := queryRequests(ctx, q, sql, args...)
119		if err != nil || len(rows) == 0 {
120			return Request{}, false, err
121		}
122		return rows[0], true, nil
123	}
124	
125	// RecordRequests stores the native-mirror regions a repo create asked for and
126	// returns their rows, each with its reserved placement id. jurisdiction is
127	// the primary's, whose regional core runs the jobs. The repo is not active
128	// yet, so nothing is published: PublishRepoRequests does that once it is, and
129	// the sweep publishes after publishAfter if that never happens. A repeated
130	// slug keeps its row.
131	func (s *Service) RecordRequests(ctx context.Context, repoID model.RepoID, jurisdiction string, createdBy model.AccountID, clusterSlugs []string, publishAfter time.Duration) ([]Request, error) {
132		var creator *string
133		if createdBy != "" {
134			v := createdBy.String()
135			creator = &v
136		}
137		placementIDs := make([]string, len(clusterSlugs))
138		for i := range clusterSlugs {
139			placementIDs[i] = model.NewRepoID().String()
140		}
141		if _, err := s.pool.Exec(ctx,
142			`INSERT INTO native_mirror_requests
143			     (repo_id, cluster_slug, placement_id, jurisdiction, created_by_account_id, next_publish_at)
144			 SELECT $1, slug, pid, $2, $3, now() + ($6::INT8 * INTERVAL '1 microsecond')
145			 FROM unnest($4::TEXT[], $5::TEXT[]) AS r(slug, pid)
146			 ON CONFLICT (repo_id, cluster_slug) DO NOTHING`,
147			repoID.String(), jurisdiction, creator, clusterSlugs, placementIDs, publishAfter.Microseconds()); err != nil {
148			return nil, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: record requests for %s: %w", repoID, err)
149		}
150		requests, err := queryRequests(ctx, s.pool,
151			`SELECT `+requestColumns+` FROM native_mirror_requests
152			 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cluster_slug = ANY($2::TEXT[]) ORDER BY cluster_slug`,
153			repoID.String(), clusterSlugs)
154		if err != nil {
155			return nil, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: read recorded requests for %s: %w", repoID, err)
156		}
157		return requests, nil
158	}
159	
160	// SubmitRequest stores a request for one region and returns it. A failed or
161	// cancelled request for the same region is reset; this is how a user retries.
162	// A live request keeps its placement id. The caller publishes the job with
163	// PublishRequest after this returns, so a consumer never sees the job before
164	// the row is committed.
165	func (s *Service) SubmitRequest(ctx context.Context, p SubmitRequestParams) (Request, error) {
166		var creator *string
167		if p.CreatedBy != "" {
168			v := p.CreatedBy.String()
169			creator = &v
170		}
171		// A row whose job is running stays processing. Its outcome, not this
172		// submit, decides what happens next.
173		req, found, err := firstRequest(ctx, s.pool,
174			`INSERT INTO native_mirror_requests
175			     (repo_id, cluster_slug, placement_id, jurisdiction, created_by_account_id, next_publish_at)
176			 VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, now() + ($6::INT8 * INTERVAL '1 microsecond'))
177			 ON CONFLICT (repo_id, cluster_slug) DO UPDATE SET
178			     status = CASE
179			         WHEN native_mirror_requests.status = 'processing' AND native_mirror_requests.cancelled_at IS NULL
180			         THEN 'processing' ELSE 'pending' END,
181			     created_at = CASE
182			         WHEN native_mirror_requests.failed_at IS NOT NULL OR native_mirror_requests.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL
183			         THEN now() ELSE native_mirror_requests.created_at END,
184			     created_by_account_id = CASE
185			         WHEN native_mirror_requests.failed_at IS NOT NULL OR native_mirror_requests.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL
186			         THEN excluded.created_by_account_id ELSE native_mirror_requests.created_by_account_id END,
187			     failed_at = NULL,
188			     cancelled_at = NULL,
189			     cancelled_by_account_id = NULL,
190			     cancel_settled_at = NULL,
191			     failure_code = NULL,
192			     failure_message = NULL,
193			     next_publish_at = excluded.next_publish_at
194			 RETURNING `+requestColumns,
195			p.RepoID.String(), p.ClusterSlug, model.NewRepoID().String(), p.Jurisdiction, creator, RequestPublishHold.Microseconds())
196		if err == nil && !found {
197			err = errors.New("upsert returned no row")
198		}
199		if err != nil {
200			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: submit request %s/%s: %w", p.RepoID, p.ClusterSlug, err)
201		}
202		return req, nil
203	}

205	// PublishRequest publishes the job of a request that SubmitRequest stored.
206	// When the publish fails, the request is rescheduled so the sweep publishes
207	// it within a minute, and the error is returned for logging.
208	func (s *Service) PublishRequest(ctx context.Context, req Request, publisher RequestPublisher) error {
209		return s.publishClaimed(ctx, []Request{req}, publisher)
210	}

212	// PublishRepoRequests publishes the job of each pending request of repoID.
213	// Repo create calls it once the repo is active. A request whose publish fails
214	// is left for the sweep, and the first such error is returned.
215	func (s *Service) PublishRepoRequests(ctx context.Context, repoID model.RepoID, publisher RequestPublisher) error {
216		claimed, err := queryRequests(ctx, s.pool,
217			`UPDATE native_mirror_requests
218			 SET next_publish_at = now() + ($2::INT8 * INTERVAL '1 microsecond')
219			 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND status = 'pending' AND failed_at IS NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL
220			 RETURNING `+requestColumns,
221			repoID.String(), RequestPublishHold.Microseconds())
222		if err != nil {
223			return fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: claim requests of %s to publish: %w", repoID, err)
224		}
225		return s.publishClaimed(ctx, claimed, publisher)
226	}

228	// PublishDueRequests publishes up to limit requests in jurisdiction whose
229	// publish is due: a lost job, a wait that ended, or a repo the provisioning
230	// reconciler activated. It returns how many it published.
231	func (s *Service) PublishDueRequests(ctx context.Context, jurisdiction string, limit int, publisher RequestPublisher) (int, error) {
232		claimed, err := s.claimDue(ctx, jurisdiction, limit, false, RequestPublishHold)
233		if err != nil {
234			return 0, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: claim due requests in %s: %w", jurisdiction, err)
235		}
236		return len(claimed), s.publishClaimed(ctx, claimed, publisher)
237	}

239	// claimDue claims up to limit open requests in jurisdiction whose
240	// next_publish_at has passed, either failed ones or the rest, and pushes their
241	// next_publish_at forward by hold so no other pod claims them meanwhile. SKIP
242	// LOCKED gives concurrent sweeps disjoint batches, as in created_outbox.go.
243	func (s *Service) claimDue(ctx context.Context, jurisdiction string, limit int, failed bool, hold time.Duration) ([]Request, error) {
244		failedCond := "failed_at IS NULL AND cancel_settled_at IS NULL"
245		if failed {
246			failedCond = "failed_at IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL"
247		}
248		claimed, err := queryRequests(ctx, s.pool,
249			`UPDATE native_mirror_requests
250			 SET next_publish_at = now() + ($3::INT8 * INTERVAL '1 microsecond')
251			 WHERE (repo_id, cluster_slug) IN (
252			     SELECT repo_id, cluster_slug FROM native_mirror_requests
253			     WHERE jurisdiction = $1 AND `+failedCond+` AND next_publish_at <= now()
254			     ORDER BY next_publish_at LIMIT $2
255			     FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
256			   AND `+failedCond+` AND next_publish_at <= now()
257			 RETURNING `+requestColumns,
258			jurisdiction, limit, hold.Microseconds())
259		return claimed, err
260	}

262	// requestPublishRetry is when the sweep tries again after a failed publish.
263	const requestPublishRetry = time.Minute
264	
265	// publishClaimed tries every claimed request, so one failure does not hold
266	// back the rest for a whole RequestPublishHold.
267	func (s *Service) publishClaimed(ctx context.Context, claimed []Request, publisher RequestPublisher) error {
268		var errs []error
269		for _, req := range claimed {
270			err := publisher.PublishRequest(ctx, req)
271			if err == nil {
272				continue
273			}
274			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: publish request %s/%s: %w", req.RepoID, req.ClusterSlug, err))
275			// Match the publish time this claim set. A resubmit or a wait since the
276			// claim set a new one, and its hold must stand.
277			if _, err := s.pool.Exec(ctx,
278				`UPDATE native_mirror_requests SET next_publish_at = now() + ($3::INT8 * INTERVAL '1 microsecond')
279				 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cluster_slug = $2 AND placement_id = $4 AND next_publish_at = $5`,
280				req.RepoID.String(), req.ClusterSlug, requestPublishRetry.Microseconds(), req.PlacementID.String(), req.NextPublishAt); err != nil {
281				errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: reschedule request %s/%s: %w", req.RepoID, req.ClusterSlug, err))
282			}
283		}
284		return errors.Join(errs...)
285	}

287	// StartRequestAttempt marks a live request as processing and returns it with
288	// its new attempt number. A cancelled request whose removal is not settled
289	// still starts, so its job can remove the intent. started is false when the
290	// request is failed, settled, or gone, so the job has nothing to do.
291	func (s *Service) StartRequestAttempt(ctx context.Context, repoID model.RepoID, clusterSlug string) (Request, bool, error) {
292		req, found, err := firstRequest(ctx, s.pool,
293			`UPDATE native_mirror_requests SET status = 'processing', attempts = attempts + 1
294			 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cluster_slug = $2 AND failed_at IS NULL AND cancel_settled_at IS NULL
295			 RETURNING `+requestColumns,
296			repoID.String(), clusterSlug)
297		if err != nil {
298			return Request{}, false, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: start request attempt %s/%s: %w", repoID, clusterSlug, err)
299		}
300		return req, found, nil
301	}

303	// sqlFragment is SQL that fencedUpdate splices into a statement. Only an
304	// untyped string constant converts to it implicitly, so a string variable
305	// holding user data does not compile as one.
306	type sqlFragment string
307	
308	// fencedUpdate applies set to the request only while attempt is still its
309	// current processing attempt. It reports whether it did. Every value goes in
310	// args as a bind parameter from $4 on.
311	func (s *Service) fencedUpdate(ctx context.Context, op string, req Request, set sqlFragment, args ...any) (bool, error) {
312		all := append([]any{req.RepoID.String(), req.ClusterSlug, req.Attempts}, args...)
313		tag, err := s.pool.Exec(ctx,
314			`UPDATE native_mirror_requests SET `+string(set)+`
315			 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cluster_slug = $2 AND attempts = $3 AND status = 'processing'
316			   AND failed_at IS NULL AND cancel_settled_at IS NULL`, all...)
317		if err != nil {
318			return false, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: %s %s/%s: %w", op, req.RepoID, req.ClusterSlug, err)
319		}
320		return tag.RowsAffected() == 1, nil
321	}
322	
323	// FinishRequest deletes the request attempt req ran, once its intent exists,
324	// unless the request was cancelled. The delete is fenced on req's attempt and
325	// placement id, so an attempt that finishes late never removes a newer
326	// request for the same region; that request's own job finishes it. cancelled
327	// is true when req's request is still there and cancelled, so the caller must
328	// remove the intent and call SettleCancelledRequest.
329	func (s *Service) FinishRequest(ctx context.Context, req Request) (Request, bool, error) {
330		tag, err := s.pool.Exec(ctx,
331			`DELETE FROM native_mirror_requests
332			 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cluster_slug = $2 AND placement_id = $3 AND attempts = $4 AND cancelled_at IS NULL`,
333			req.RepoID.String(), req.ClusterSlug, req.PlacementID.String(), req.Attempts)
334		if err != nil {
335			return Request{}, false, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: finish request %s/%s: %w", req.RepoID, req.ClusterSlug, err)
336		}
337		if tag.RowsAffected() == 1 {
338			return Request{}, false, nil
339		}
340		current, found, err := firstRequest(ctx, s.pool,
341			`SELECT `+requestColumns+` FROM native_mirror_requests WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cluster_slug = $2`,
342			req.RepoID.String(), req.ClusterSlug)
343		if err != nil {
344			return Request{}, false, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: read finished request %s/%s: %w", req.RepoID, req.ClusterSlug, err)
345		}
346		return current, found && current.CancelledAt != nil && current.PlacementID == req.PlacementID, nil
347	}

349	// SettleCancelledRequest records that the job of a cancelled request removed
350	// any intent it created, so the request is no longer run and can be purged.
351	// It reports false when the request is no longer cancelled, because a user
352	// asked for the region again.
353	//
354	// status goes back to pending only to say no job holds the row; there is no
355	// settled status. cancel_settled_at alone keeps the row from running again:
356	// claimDue, StartRequestAttempt and the fenced updates all require it to be
357	// NULL, and PublishRepoRequests requires cancelled_at to be NULL.
358	func (s *Service) SettleCancelledRequest(ctx context.Context, repoID model.RepoID, clusterSlug string) (bool, error) {
359		tag, err := s.pool.Exec(ctx,
360			`UPDATE native_mirror_requests SET cancel_settled_at = now(), status = 'pending'
361			 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cluster_slug = $2 AND cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND cancel_settled_at IS NULL`,
362			repoID.String(), clusterSlug)
363		if err != nil {
364			return false, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: settle cancelled request %s/%s: %w", repoID, clusterSlug, err)
365		}
366		return tag.RowsAffected() == 1, nil
367	}

387	// RecordRequestWait returns the attempt to pending and lets the sweep publish
388	// the job again after wait. Waits that end on their own, such as a primary
389	// that is still provisioning, use this instead of JetStream redelivery.
390	func (s *Service) RecordRequestWait(ctx context.Context, req Request, lastError string, wait time.Duration) (bool, error) {
391		return s.fencedUpdate(ctx, "record request wait", req,

393			lastError, wait.Microseconds())
394	}

396	// requestFailedRecheck is how often the sweep checks that a failed request's
397	// repo still exists.
398	const requestFailedRecheck = time.Hour

400	// RecordRequestFailure marks a request that cannot succeed. code and message
401	// are shown to users; lastError is for operators. The row stays so the repo
402	// shows the region as failed.
403	func (s *Service) RecordRequestFailure(ctx context.Context, req Request, code, message, lastError string) (bool, error) {
404		if code == "" || message == "" {
405			return false, errors.New("nativemirror: failure code and message are required")
406		}
407		return s.fencedUpdate(ctx, "record request failure", req,
408			`status = 'failed', failed_at = now(), failure_code = $4, failure_message = $5, last_error = $6,
409			 next_publish_at = now() + ($7::INT8 * INTERVAL '1 microsecond')`,
410			code, message, lastError, requestFailedRecheck.Microseconds())
411	}

413	// ListRequests returns the repo's requests that are not cancelled, ordered by

417			`SELECT `+requestColumns+` FROM native_mirror_requests
418			 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cancelled_at IS NULL ORDER BY cluster_slug`, repoID.String())
419		if err != nil {

425	// CancelRequest marks an open request as cancelled by cancelledBy and returns
426	// it. found is false when there was no open request. The cancel queues the
427	// row at once, so its job removes any intent and settles it; a failed request
428	// is cleared first, so it does not stay stranded where no job runs.
429	func (s *Service) CancelRequest(ctx context.Context, repoID model.RepoID, clusterSlug string, cancelledBy model.AccountID) (Request, bool, error) {
430		req, found, err := firstRequest(ctx, s.pool,
431			`UPDATE native_mirror_requests SET cancelled_at = now(), cancelled_by_account_id = NULLIF($3, ''),
432			     failed_at = NULL, status = CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 'pending' ELSE status END,
433			     next_publish_at = now()
434			 WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cluster_slug = $2 AND cancelled_at IS NULL
435			 RETURNING `+requestColumns,
436			repoID.String(), clusterSlug, string(cancelledBy))
437		if err != nil {
438			return Request{}, false, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: cancel request %s/%s: %w", repoID, clusterSlug, err)
439		}
440		return req, found, nil
441	}

443	// DeleteRequest removes one request, cancelled or not, and returns it. found
444	// is false when there was none.
445	func (s *Service) DeleteRequest(ctx context.Context, repoID model.RepoID, clusterSlug string) (Request, bool, error) {
446		req, found, err := firstRequest(ctx, s.pool,
447			`DELETE FROM native_mirror_requests WHERE repo_id = $1 AND cluster_slug = $2
448			 RETURNING `+requestColumns,
449			repoID.String(), clusterSlug)
450		if err != nil {
451			return Request{}, false, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: delete request %s/%s: %w", repoID, clusterSlug, err)
452		}
453		return req, found, nil
454	}

456	// PurgeCancelledRequests deletes cancelled requests in jurisdiction whose
457	// removal settled more than olderThan ago. olderThan must exceed the longest
458	// job attempt: an attempt that started before the cancel reads the row when
459	// it finishes, and removes the intent it created.
460	func (s *Service) PurgeCancelledRequests(ctx context.Context, jurisdiction string, olderThan time.Duration) error {
461		_, err := s.pool.Exec(ctx,
462			`DELETE FROM native_mirror_requests
463			 WHERE jurisdiction = $1 AND cancel_settled_at < now() - ($2::INT8 * INTERVAL '1 microsecond')`,
464			jurisdiction, olderThan.Microseconds())
465		if err != nil {
466			return fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: purge cancelled requests in %s: %w", jurisdiction, err)
467		}
468		return nil
469	}

471	// OldestOpenRequestAgeSeconds returns the age of the oldest request in
472	// jurisdiction that is neither failed nor cancelled, or zero when none is.
473	func (s *Service) OldestOpenRequestAgeSeconds(ctx context.Context, jurisdiction string) (int64, error) {
474		var age int64
475		err := s.pool.QueryRow(ctx,
476			`SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - min(created_at))::INT8, 0)
477			 FROM native_mirror_requests
478			 WHERE jurisdiction = $1 AND failed_at IS NULL AND cancel_settled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL`,
479			jurisdiction).Scan(&age)
480		if err != nil {
481			return 0, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: oldest open request in %s: %w", jurisdiction, err)
482		}
483		return age, nil
484	}

486	// ClaimFailedRequestsForCheck returns up to limit failed requests in
487	// jurisdiction that are due for a check that their repo still exists, and
488	// pushes their next check back by an hour. Publishing never picks failed
489	// rows, so next_publish_at is free to schedule this check.
490	func (s *Service) ClaimFailedRequestsForCheck(ctx context.Context, jurisdiction string, limit int) ([]Request, error) {
491		claimed, err := s.claimDue(ctx, jurisdiction, limit, true, requestFailedRecheck)
492		if err != nil {
493			return nil, fmt.Errorf("nativemirror: claim failed requests in %s: %w", jurisdiction, err)
494		}
495		return claimed, nil
496	}

69	// New validates cfg and returns a Consumer.
70	func New(cfg Config) (*Consumer, error) {
71		switch {
72		case cfg.Conn == nil:
73			return nil, errors.New("nativemirrorcreate: Conn is required")
74		case cfg.Store == nil:
75			return nil, errors.New("nativemirrorcreate: Store is required")
76		case cfg.Runner == nil:
77			return nil, errors.New("nativemirrorcreate: Runner is required")
78		case cfg.DLQ == nil:
79			return nil, errors.New("nativemirrorcreate: DLQ is required")
80		case cfg.Jurisdiction == "":
81			return nil, errors.New("nativemirrorcreate: Jurisdiction is required")
82		}
83		return &Consumer{cfg: cfg}, nil

86	// Run consumes jobs until ctx is cancelled.
87	func (c *Consumer) Run(ctx context.Context) {
88		err := jsconsumer.Run(ctx, c.cfg.Conn, jsconsumer.Config{
89			Name:           "native-mirror-create",
90			Stream:         repoops.StreamName,
91			Durable:        durableNamePrefix + c.cfg.Jurisdiction,
92			FilterSubject:  subjectFilter(c.cfg.Jurisdiction),
93			AckWait:        ackWait,
94			MaxDeliver:     maxDeliver,
95			MaxMessages:    1,
96			KeepInProgress: true,
97		}, func(ctx context.Context, msg jetstream.Msg) {
98			c.handleMessage(ctx, msg)
99		})
100		if err != nil {
101			slogutil.Error(ctx, "native-mirror-create consumer stopped", slog.String("error", err.Error()))
102		}
103	}

105	func (c *Consumer) handleMessage(ctx context.Context, msg jetstream.Msg) {
106		ctx = natsmsg.ExtractHeader(ctx, msg.Headers())
107		stopHeartbeat := natsmsg.KeepInProgress(msg.InProgress, ackWait)
108		defer stopHeartbeat()
109		defer func() {
110			if recovered := recover(); recovered != nil {
111				slogutil.Error(ctx, "native-mirror-create delivery panicked",
112					slog.Any("panic", recovered), slog.String("stack", string(debug.Stack())))
113				c.nak(ctx, msg, fmt.Errorf("native-mirror-create delivery panicked: %v", recovered))
114			}
115		}()
116	
117		parsed, err := repoops.ParseSubject(msg.Subject())
118		if err != nil {
119			c.deadLetterAndAck(ctx, msg, "bad_subject", err)
120			return
121		}
122		j, repoID, err := unmarshalJob(msg.Data())
123		if err != nil {
124			c.deadLetterAndAck(ctx, msg, "bad_payload", err)
125			return
126		}
127		if parsed.Placement.Jurisdiction != c.cfg.Jurisdiction || parsed.Placement.ClusterSlug != j.ClusterSlug {
128			c.deadLetterAndAck(ctx, msg, "route_mismatch", fmt.Errorf(
129				"subject %s does not route job for %s/%s in %s", msg.Subject(), repoID, j.ClusterSlug, c.cfg.Jurisdiction))
130			return
131		}
132	
133		req, started, err := c.cfg.Store.StartRequestAttempt(ctx, repoID, j.ClusterSlug)
134		if err != nil {
135			c.nak(ctx, msg, err)
136			return
137		}
138		if !started {
139			// Failed, cancelled, or already done: nothing is left to run.
140			c.ack(ctx, msg)
141			return
142		}
143		if req.Jurisdiction != c.cfg.Jurisdiction {
144			c.deadLetterAndAck(ctx, msg, "route_mismatch", fmt.Errorf(
145				"request %s/%s belongs to %s, consumer is %s", repoID, j.ClusterSlug, req.Jurisdiction, c.cfg.Jurisdiction))
146			return
147		}
148		c.execute(ctx, msg, req)
149	}
150	
151	func (c *Consumer) execute(ctx context.Context, msg jetstream.Msg, req nativemirror.Request) {
152		ctx, span := otel.Tracer("entire.io/internal/entirecore/nativemirrorcreate").Start(ctx, "native-mirror-create.execute",
153			trace.WithSpanKind(trace.SpanKindConsumer),
154			trace.WithAttributes(
155				attribute.String("repo_id", req.RepoID.String()),
156				attribute.String("cluster_slug", req.ClusterSlug),
157				attribute.String("placement_id", req.PlacementID.String()),
158				attribute.Int64("attempt", req.Attempts),
159				attribute.String("messaging.destination.name", msg.Subject()),
160			),
161		)
162		startedAt := time.Now()
163		outcome := c.run(ctx, req)
164		kind := string(outcome.Kind)
165		defer func() {
166			span.SetAttributes(attribute.String("native_mirror_request.outcome", kind))
167			recordExecution(ctx, c.cfg.Jurisdiction, kind, outcome.Code, time.Since(startedAt))
168			span.End()
169		}()
170		if outcome.Err != nil {
171			span.RecordError(outcome.Err)
172		}
173	
174		var (
175			applied bool
176			err     error
177		)
178		switch outcome.Kind {
179		case coreapi.NativeMirrorRequestDone, coreapi.NativeMirrorRequestDropped:
180			c.ack(ctx, msg)
181			return
182		case coreapi.NativeMirrorRequestFail:
183			applied, err = c.cfg.Store.RecordRequestFailure(ctx, req, outcome.Code, outcome.Message, errText(outcome.Err))
184		case coreapi.NativeMirrorRequestWait:
185			applied, err = c.cfg.Store.RecordRequestWait(ctx, req, errText(outcome.Err), outcome.Wait)
186		case coreapi.NativeMirrorRequestRetry:
187			if backoff.IsFinalDelivery(msg, maxDeliver) {
188				kind = "exhausted"
189				applied, err = c.cfg.Store.RecordRequestWait(ctx, req, errText(outcome.Err), exhaustedWait)
190				break
191			}
192			applied, err = c.cfg.Store.RecordRequestRetry(ctx, req, errText(outcome.Err))
193			if err == nil && applied {
194				c.nak(ctx, msg, outcome.Err)
195				return
196			}
197		default:
198			c.nak(ctx, msg, fmt.Errorf("unknown native-mirror request outcome %q", outcome.Kind))
199			return
200		}
201		if err != nil {
202			c.nak(ctx, msg, fmt.Errorf("record %s outcome: %w", kind, err))
203			return
204		}
205		if !applied {
206			// A newer attempt, a cancel, or a retry reset owns the row now.
207			kind = "superseded"
208		}
209		c.ack(ctx, msg)
210	}
211	
212	func (c *Consumer) run(ctx context.Context, req nativemirror.Request) (outcome coreapi.NativeMirrorRequestOutcome) {
213		defer func() {
214			if recovered := recover(); recovered != nil {
215				slogutil.Error(ctx, "native-mirror-create runner panicked",
216					slog.Any("panic", recovered), slog.String("stack", string(debug.Stack())))
217				outcome = coreapi.NativeMirrorRequestOutcome{Kind: coreapi.NativeMirrorRequestRetry, Err: fmt.Errorf("runner panicked: %v", recovered)}
218			}
219		}()
220		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, attemptTimeout)
221		defer cancel()
222		return c.cfg.Runner.Run(ctx, req)
223	}
224	
225	func errText(err error) string {
226		if err == nil {
227			return ""
228		}
229		return err.Error()
230	}
231	
232	func (c *Consumer) deadLetterAndAck(ctx context.Context, msg jetstream.Msg, reason string, cause error) {
233		if err := natsmsg.DeadLetter(ctx, c.cfg.DLQ, dlqSubjectPrefix+natsmsg.SubjectToken(reason), msg, reason); err != nil {
234			c.nak(ctx, msg, errors.Join(cause, err))
235			return
236		}
237		c.ack(ctx, msg)
238	}
239	
240	func (c *Consumer) ack(ctx context.Context, msg jetstream.Msg) {
241		if err := msg.Ack(); err != nil {
242			slogutil.Warn(ctx, "native-mirror-create ack failed", slog.String("error", err.Error()))
243		}
244	}
245	
246	func (c *Consumer) nak(ctx context.Context, msg jetstream.Msg, cause error) {
247		delay := retryPolicy.DelayFor(backoff.NumDelivered(msg))
248		slogutil.Warn(ctx, "native-mirror-create job failed; will retry",
249			slog.Duration("delay", delay), slog.String("error", errText(cause)))
250		if err := msg.NakWithDelay(delay); err != nil {
251			slogutil.Warn(ctx, "native-mirror-create nak failed", slog.String("error", err.Error()))
252		}
253	}
